faqs.question: How do I research Web3 teams?
faqs.answer: Check team backgrounds on LinkedIn, verify past projects, look for GitHub activity, and assess community reputation. Anonymous teams carry higher risk.

faqs.question: What makes a strong Web3 team?
faqs.answer: Previous successful projects, technical depth, transparent communication, aligned token incentives, and genuine community engagement. Past performance matters.

faqs.question: How do VCs evaluate crypto projects?
faqs.answer: Team quality, technology innovation, market size, tokenomics, competitive positioning, and traction. Early stage focuses on team, later stage on metrics.
